summary: Session 2 of 3 built the deterministic tag-triggered NuGet publish pipeline and PUBLISHED the first version. tools/pack.ps1 gained CleanOutput/TreatWarningsAsErrors; .github/workflows/build.yml (renamed from nuget-publish.yml) builds the publish surface via Dabbler.Publish.slnf, packs the 15-ID allowlist, runs surface + consumer smoke tests, and pushes to nuget.org via OIDC TRUSTED PUBLISHING (NuGet/login@v1, id-token: write; no long-lived secret) - superseding the Decision 5 scoped-API-key mechanic. Four CI-only failures were debugged and fixed (regex, sibling-repo build scope, transitive-build pack, .slnx restore). All 15 Dabbler.* packages (+ snupkg symbols) published at 0.1.0-preview.1; owner reviewed and accepted the full public set. No env approval gate is possible (private repo / plan without protection rules). Cross-provider verification (Gemini 2.5 Pro): ISSUES_FOUND, no Critical; dispositioned to no blocking defects (1 false-positive rejected, 1 hardening deferred, minors resolved).

reason.specifics: Session 3 (consumer wiring) is template nuget.config edits + docs + a clean-machine scaffold validation against the now-live feed; a tier-2 model handles it well below Opus cost. Per the routed ai-assignment analysis.
